'''Kel Dor''', or '''Kel Dorian''', was the native language of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] species from [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. Most Kel Dor were fluent in both Kel Dor and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]],<ref name="u">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> preferring to use Basic over their own language when away from their homeworld due to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] atmospheres making it more difficult to understand.<ref name="FaD" /> The language had a written form.<ref name="u" />

It was easier to speak the language when in Dorin's atmosphere, though this did not prevent some non-Kel Dor from learning the language. [[Vylanthar Merric]]<ref name="Shadows in the Force">"[[Shadows in the Force]]"</ref> and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Doel Scherp]]<ref name="The Betrayal of Darth Revan">"[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]"</ref> both had learned the language, as well as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]]<ref name="p">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="Malevolence Commentary">{{SW|url=video/rising-malevolence-episode-featurette|text="Rising Malevolence" Episode Featurette}}</ref>

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Originally in [[Rising Malevolence|"Rising ''Malevolence''"]], Plo Koon was going to speak only in Kel Dor, but he ended up speaking Basic in it because the makers came to the conclusion watchers needed to be able to understand him due to the importance of the conversations with the clones under his command.<ref name="Malevolence Commentary" />

In the comic "[[One Battle]]", [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] has some lines in Kel Dorian; the words in the speech balloons are in English, with the letters replaced by some alien font. Only his last line (see infobox) is translated by the [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando commander (Aridka)|ARC commander]]: "One Battle, One Jedi". By applying these known letters and replacing them in his previous balloons, it is possible to guess what he said in them: "Your request was received" and "Get me on top of that battle ship".
